tei:div.tei:p: 'jig rten pa la gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyir song ste/ phyogs skyong gi gtsang gtor dang 'byung po dang bgegs kyi gtor ma bza' bca' sna tshogs bshams la/00000000 dang po sngon 'gro ltar/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la sogs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba bskyed par gyur/ oṃ a kā ros byin gyis brlabs nas/ phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba dbang dang ldan// snying rje thabs mkhas thugs rje dkyil po che// lha dang drang srong yi dwags srin po klu// rig 'dzin rgyal po dang ni gnod sbyin bdag /de dag so so'i dbang po'i skur ston pa// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba bzhugs so 'tshal// bstan pa rgyas pa'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod cing gshegs su gsol// oṃ da sha dig lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ pad+ma kā ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ in+d+ra ya/ ag+na ye/ ya ma ye/ nai re tā ya/ wā ru ṇā ya/ wā ya we/ ku we rā ya/ ī sha nā ya/ ūr+dhaṃ/ prah+mā ya/ sūr+ya/ praha a dhi pa ta ye/ tsan+d+ra nak+ṣa tra/ a dhi pa ta ye/ a dho pri thī be bh+yaḥ a su re bh+yaḥ nā ge bh+yaḥ sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nyer spyod kyis mchod/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha// lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po= shar lho= mchod cing = gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha// ma mo'i rgyal po= lho phyogs= mchod cing= bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha// srin po'i rgyal po= lho nub= mchod cing= zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha// klu yi rgyal po= nub phyogs=

mchod cing= rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha// rig 'dzin rgyal po= nub byang = mchod cing= gnod sbyin lag na dbyug to 'dzin// nor skyong rgyal po= byang phyogs= mchod cing= dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha// 'byung po rgyal po= byang shar= mchod cing= steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang*// nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po*// gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la// mchod cing= 'og gi klu ste sa yi bdag /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang*// dam tshig gshegs pa'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// rdor thal kha phye bas/ in+d+ra ye sogs kyi mthar/ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+ya sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ grih+ṇa daṃ ba l+yā te swā hā/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// gtor ma 'bul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol// me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang*// dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang*// steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang*// lha rnams kun dang gang dag sa steng klu// ri yi lha dang gtsang ma'i tshogs bcas la// sa sa so sor gtor ma phul ba rnams// rab tu dgyes pa'i yid kyis bzhes nas su// rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas kyang*// rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun bcas// nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs gcig tu// phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas// bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na// 'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas kyang*// bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// oṃ in+d+ra ya/ ag+na ye/ ya ma ye/ nai ri tā ya/ wā ru ṇā ya/ wā ya we/ ku be rā ya/ ī sha nā ya/ ūr+dhaṃ/ prah+mā ya/ sūr+ya pra hi a dhi pa ta ye/ tsan+d+ra nak+ṣa tra a bhi pa ta ye/ a dho pri thī be bh+yaḥ a su re bh+yaḥ nā ge bh+yaḥ

sa pa ri wā ra gats+tshas gshegs/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul// nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po// dri za srin po gdon gyi rigs rnams dang*// gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can// bu smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa la// bdag gi pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni// thal mo sbyar nas khyod la gsol 'debs kyi// gsan nas phan gdags slad du 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ sarba lo ka pā la e h+ye hi/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ ar+ghaṃ pra ti ts+tsha swā hā/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wid+ya/ shap+da dang*/ oṃ de ba/ nā ga yak+ṣa/ ghan+dharba/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kiṃ na ra/ ma ho ra ga ma nuṣ+ya/ a ma nuṣ+ya/ sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mi khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛ+-ih+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā te swā hā/ gsum mam bdun dang se gol gtogs/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang*// dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang*// shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang*// ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang*// rin chen gling na lhag par gang gnas dang*// chu bo kun dang chu yi mdo rnams dang*// mtsho dang rdzing bu lteng ka chu ngogs dang*// g.ya' chu sil ma can la gang gnas dang*// grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong pa dang*// khang stong dag dang lha yi gnas rnams dang*// gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas rnams dang*// dka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres rnams dang*// rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang*// lam srang sum mdo dang ni bzhi mdo dang*// gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung*// dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang*// seng ge dred dang gcan gzan gnas rnams dang*// 'brog chen 'jigs su rung ba gang gnas dang*// gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang*// lhun po'i dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams// rab tu dgyes shing mgu bar gyur nas su// phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug pa bcas// bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na// 'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas kyang*// bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// oṃ de ba/

nā ga yak+ṣa/ ghan+dharba/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kiṃ na ra/ ma ho ra ga ma nuṣ+ya/ a ma nuṣ+ya/ sa pā ri wā ra gats+tsha/ bgegs gtor ni/ bdag nyid khro bo 'jig rten gsum rgyal sku mdog sngon po dbu dang phyag mtha' yas pa/ sbrul dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan dang*/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya/ lhag ma'i g.yas rnams mtshon cha sna tshogs/ g.yon rnams mgo thod shas gang ba bsnams pas ma rungs pa'i rgyu ma drangs te gsol ba/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang gzungs sngags rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i mthus/ bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa thams cad 'dir mchis par gyur cig ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ gung ka ri gung ka ri swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swā hā/ oṃ gung gung swā hā/ sarba bigh+nān gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ gung ka ri gung ka ri swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swā hā/ oṃ gung gung swā hā/ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇa daṃ ba l+yā di swā hā/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma byin la/ gang zhig mtshan mo rgyu ba yi// 'byung po rnams dang sha za dang*// srin po sha rjen za ba dang*// sems can rnam pa sna tshogs dang*// ljon shing gel pa sogs gnas pa// de dang de la gtor ma ni// bza' bca' sha chang la phug bcas// 'bras chan 'bras bu mang po yi// mchod sbyin 'di yis mgu byos la// gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*// bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i yid// de ring phyin chad bskyed par gyis// rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing*// dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod// 'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ste// dge slong dge sbyong de yin bram ze'ang de// mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med// 'tshe ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzem// rang gi lus la dpe longs la// gzhan la gnod pa byed cig

/oṃ/ chen po'am chung ngu gang dag gis// lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa'i// nad de myur du phyungs nas su// gdon de rang gi gnas su dengs// de ltar bdag gis ci nus kyis// mchod dang bsnyen bkur byas pa yis// dam tshig la ni gnas nas su// bdag gi bsam pa bskang bar mdzod// rtag tu dam tshig la gnas shing*// 'dir ni bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// nad de rab tu sel mdzod la// gdon rnams rang gi gnas su song*// oṃ sarba bigh+nān gats+tshas gshegs/ nye reg ni/ tsog pu lag g.yas g.yon du chu gtsang blugs nas g.yas pa'i sor rtses blangs te/ rna ba gnyis/ mig gnyis/ sna bug gnyis/ pus mo/ mgo/ lte ba'i phyogs la reg /chu lhag mas kha bshal la/ nang du phyin nas dkyil 'khor la phyag dang mchod bstod ci rigs bya'o//
